commands.name: list-genres
commands.summary: List all genres in MusicBrainz, with each genre's name and detail URL (the MBID is in the URL)

commands.name: get-genre
commands.summary: Get one genre: name, primary tag, relationships (parent genres, subgenres, fusions/influences) and its Wikipedia summary

commands.name: get-wikipedia-extract
commands.summary: Get the cached Wikipedia summary (HTML) for a genre, instrument, artist or release group; wikipediaExtract is null when none is linked

commands.name: list-instruments
commands.summary: List all instruments, each with its name, short description and detail URL (the MBID is in the URL)

commands.name: get-instrument
commands.summary: Get one instrument: name, type, description, relationships (subtypes, parent type, related instruments) and Wikidata link

commands.name: list-instrument-artists
commands.summary: List artists credited with playing an instrument, with artist type, gender, area and credit (paginated)

commands.name: list-instrument-releases
commands.summary: List releases featuring an instrument, with artist, format, tracks, country, date, label and catalog number (paginated)

commands.name: list-instrument-recordings
commands.summary: List recordings featuring an instrument, with artist and length (paginated)

commands.name: list-entity-tags
commands.summary: List the user-applied tags (with vote counts and any linked genre) on an instrument, artist or release group

commands.name: get-artist
commands.summary: Get an artist's details: name, type, country, begin/end dates, area, genres and external links (relations: Discogs, Wikidata, etc.)

commands.name: get-release-group
commands.summary: Get a release group (album/single): title, artist credit, type, first release date, genres, external links and its list of release versions

commands.name: list-release-group-releases
commands.summary: List every release version of a release group, with date, country, status, barcode, labels/catalog numbers and media formats

commands.name: get-statistics
commands.summary: Get the database statistics overview: counts of artists, releases, recordings, labels, works, disc IDs, editors, etc.

commands.name: get-country-statistics
commands.summary: Get per-country counts of artists, releases, labels, events and places, ranked

commands.name: get-statistic-timeline
commands.summary: Get the historical time series for one statistic as a map of date -> value (e.g. artist or release count over time)

commands.name: list-history-events
commands.summary: List MusicBrainz project milestones (date, title, description, blog link) shown on the statistics timeline

commands.name: list-relationship-type-pairs
commands.summary: List the entity-type pairs that have relationship types (e.g. Artist-Instrument), each with a link to its relationship types

commands.name: list-relationship-types
commands.summary: List the relationship types between two entity types (e.g. artist-instrument), with link phrases, description and documentation link
